newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Passengers stranded as Czech rail strike bites.
newsitem.headline: Passengers stranded as Czech rail strike bites.

text.p: The entire Czech railway network came to a halt on Tuesday morning at the start of a nationwide 48-hour strike called by unions demanding a complete overhaul of the decrepit rail system.
From midnight, domestic and international passengers were stranded throughout the country, sometimes on freezing platforms, with little hope of reaching their next destination for at least two days.

The Association of Unions of Rail Workers (OSZ), has threatended to prolong the stoppage if it does not get sufficient guarantees that repairs will be made to what it says are massive problems in the quality of the railway system.
"It will be repeated every 24 hours," the OSZ said in a statement on Monday.
The railway workers' action comes at a time of mounting labour tensions in the public sector.
Last week, teachers began a rotating strike in selected schools and there is simmering discontent in the health sector which led to sporadic industrial action last year.
